chroma-js.note: BSD-3-Clause AND Apache-2.0 (dual terms in the license field).

color-map.note: None. package.json has no dependencies; the CLI bundle inlines its parser.

@texel/color.note: None; the README says zero dependencies.

lightningcss.note: One: detect-libc. The CSS engine is a native Rust binary installed as a platform package.

color-map.note: types field points to esm/index.d.ts; every export entry has types.

culori.note: No .d.ts files or types field in the 4.0.2 package. Types come from the separate @types/culori.

colorjs.io.note: types field and per-export types under ./types.

chroma-js.note: No .d.ts files or types field in the 3.2.0 package. Types come from the separate @types/chroma-js.

colord.note: types field points to index.d.ts; plugins ship .d.ts files.

color-map.note: type module, sideEffects false, subpath exports for color, scale, palette, export.

culori.note: ESM source; sideEffects lists only 3 entry files; exports ./fn gives a function-only entry.

colorjs.io.note: ESM source; sideEffects lists 4 files; exports ./fn and ./spaces for selective imports.

chroma-js.note: ESM with per-module subpath exports and a ./light build; no sideEffects field, so bundlers may keep modules.

@texel/color.note: ESM; README says unused spaces are tree-shaken (~3.5 kB for OKLCH to sRGB). No sideEffects field.

lightningcss.note: Native binary behind a Node API; there is no JS color code to tree-shake. Not applicable to the design.

colord.note: sideEffects false; plugins are separate subpath exports.

color-map.note: 15: srgb, srgb-linear, hsl, hwb, lab, lch, oklab, oklch, display-p3 (and linear), a98-rgb, prophoto-rgb, rec2020, xyz-d50, xyz-d65.

culori.note: Includes rgb, lrgb, hsl, hsv, hsi, hwb, lab, lch, oklab, oklch, okhsl, okhsv, p3, a98, prophoto, rec2020, jab, jch, luv, xyz50, xyz65, cubehelix.

colorjs.io.note: Includes srgb, p3, a98rgb, prophoto, rec2020, rec2100, hsl, hwb, lab, lch, oklab, oklch, okhsl, okhsv, jzazbz, ictcp, cam16, hct, luv, acescg.

chroma-js.note: rgb, hsl, hsv, hsi, cmyk, lab, lch, hcl, oklab, oklch, hcg, gl, temperature. No P3, Adobe RGB, ProPhoto or Rec.2020 module in src/io.

@texel/color.note: Small set: xyz, oklab, oklch, okhsv, okhsl, srgb, display-p3, rec2020, a98-rgb, prophoto-rgb (plus linear forms). Others via custom spaces.

lightningcss.note: Parses and lowers rgb, hsl, hwb, lab, lch, oklab, oklch and color() spaces such as display-p3, xyz and a98-rgb. It does not expose a color API.

colord.note: Core: rgb, hsl, hsv. Plugins add hwb, cmyk, lab, lch, xyz and names. No oklab, oklch or P3 in the package.

color-map.note: parse(): hex, named, rgb, hsl, hwb, lab, lch, oklab, oklch, color() with 9 spaces, none. parseExpr() adds relative colors, color-mix(), light-dark().

culori.note: Parses hex, named, rgb, hsl, hwb, lab, lch, oklab, oklch, color() and none. No relative colors, color-mix() or light-dark() in src.

colorjs.io.note: parse() reads function syntax incl. color() and none. No color-mix(), relative color or light-dark() parsing; tryColor defers those to the DOM.

chroma-js.note: Parses hex, named, rgb, hsl, lab, lch, oklab, oklch and none. No hwb() or color() in src/io/css, and no relative, color-mix() or light-dark().

@texel/color.note: deserialize() reads hex, rgb(), oklch(), oklab() and plain color() only; README says complex CSS strings are out of scope.

lightningcss.note: Parses stylesheets, not strings: lab, lch, oklab, oklch, hwb, color(), color-mix(), relative colors, light-dark(); none is in the AST.

colord.note: Core parses hex, rgb, hsl; plugins add names, hwb, lch, cmyk. No oklab, oklch, color(), none, relative colors or color-mix().

color-map.note: toCss() prints rgb, hsl, hwb, lab, lch, oklab, oklch and color(<space> ...); toHex() for hex.

culori.note: formatCss() prints oklch(), lab(), color(display-p3 ...) and other color() forms; formatHex, formatRgb, formatHsl too.

colorjs.io.note: toString() prints oklch() and other function forms, or color(<space> ...); format and precision options.

chroma-js.note: css() prints rgb, hsl, lab, lch, oklab, oklch. No color() output.

@texel/color.note: serialize() prints rgb(), oklch() and color(display-p3 ...) with alpha.

lightningcss.note: Output lowers or keeps lab, oklch and color() per browser targets; there is no call to serialize one color.

colord.note: Prints hex, rgb, hsl, plus hwb, cmyk, lch via plugins. No oklch() or color() output.

color-map.note: toGamut() with method css follows the CSS Color 4 OKLCH chroma reduction (section 13.2, JND 0.02); clip also available.

culori.note: toGamut() defaults follow the CSS Color 4 algorithm per its source comment; also clampChroma and clampRgb.

colorjs.io.note: toGamut() method css is the default; also clip, raytrace and per-coordinate reduction.

chroma-js.note: No gamut-mapping module in src; only a clipped() flag that reports clipping during conversion.

@texel/color.note: gamutMapOKLCH() uses Ottosson's cusp method, not the CSS Color 4 algorithm; several mapping strategies.

lightningcss.note: Docs and types show no gamut-mapping option; could not confirm how out-of-gamut lab or oklch is converted to RGB fallbacks.

colord.note: No gamut or wide-gamut code in the 2.10.0 package (searched for gamut, oklab, oklch, display-p3).

color-map.note: WCAG 2 ratio only; APCA is available through a documented recipe, not the CLI.

culori.note: wcagContrast and wcagLuminance; no APCA in src.

colorjs.io.note: WCAG 2.1, APCA, Weber, Michelson, Lstar and DeltaPhi in src/contrast.

chroma-js.note: contrast() for WCAG 2 and contrastAPCA(); the source calls the APCA implementation beta.

@texel/color.note: No contrast or luminance function in src or README; only deltaEOK for color difference.

lightningcss.note: Node API types expose no contrast function; it is a CSS transformer.

colord.note: WCAG 2.0 luminance, contrast and isReadable via the a11y plugin; no APCA.

color-map.note: createScale (Tailwind, Radix, tone, even presets), brand and contrast scales, tonalPalette, semantic palette, harmony, mix().

culori.note: interpolate with easing and hints, samples, average, blend.

colorjs.io.note: range(), steps(), mix() with hue interpolation modes.

chroma-js.note: scale, bezier, cubehelix, average, mix, blend and random generators in src/generator.

@texel/color.note: Only lerp and lerpAngle; README says to build color interpolation yourself.

lightningcss.note: No color scale or interpolation API; checked Node API types.

colord.note: mix plugin (lab or rgb), tints, shades, tones; harmonies plugin. No multi-stop scale.

color-map.note: resolve() evaluates color-mix(), relative colors with calc(), light-dark() and contrast-color() given a context.

culori.note: No color-mix, light-dark or relative-color code in 4.0.2 src (searched).

colorjs.io.note: Not evaluated in parse; tryColor can ask the browser DOM to resolve them. mix() is a JS function, not color-mix().

chroma-js.note: No color-mix or relative-color code in 3.2.0 src (searched).

@texel/color.note: README says complex CSS color string handling is out of scope.

lightningcss.note: Evaluates color-mix() and relative colors statically when all components are known; light-dark() lowers to a variable fallback.

colord.note: The mix plugin is a JS method, not CSS color-mix(); no relative color parsing in the package.

color-map.note: ESM and CJS builds; no node: imports in src outside the CLI.

culori.note: ESM source and a bundled build; no node: imports in src.

colorjs.io.note: ESM source and dist bundles; no node: imports in src.

chroma-js.note: ESM source plus UMD builds; no node: imports in src.

@texel/color.note: README shows Canvas2D use; no node: imports in src.

lightningcss.note: Native Rust parser, transformer and minifier with a Node API, so not a browser color library. A separate lightningcss-wasm package runs in browsers.

colord.note: README says it supports all browsers and Node.js.
